text:
Nora (CS): drafting a tiny customer-facing kickoff checklist for teams using streaming + prefill. want it short and scriptable for calls.

Ethan (Solutions): thumbs up. should cover: quick smoke, starter settings, and when to escalate.

Nora (CS): 45s customer checklist to run on call:
- Confirm expected QPS range (e.g., 5-50 req/min)
- Run a 3-min prefill with real prompts (prefill ~= 80-200 tokens)
- Watch for first-token p95 and token cadence over stream
- Ensure wss is allowed through firewall/proxy

Sam (SRE): starter config snippet customers can paste:
```
prefill.enabled=true
prefill.size=100
prefill.ttl=600
batch.max_inflight=6
stream.keepalive=20
```

Clara (Customer): please add a non-technical PM question: "Is low latency business-critical? (yes/partial/no)"

Nora (CS): added. escalation rules (auto): p95 first-token > 800ms OR stream.errors > 2% -> flag as "latency-risk" and loop infra. cache.hit_ratio < 40% -> request model prefix hints.

Ethan (Solutions): quick admin triage tips for customer admins:
- Websocket smoke: `wscat -c wss://api.redwood.ai/stream` (should see token frames within 3s)
- Console -> filter events `prefill.*` to confirm prefill.success
- If eviction spikes, increase prefill.ttl (600 -> 1200) and reduce max_inflight by 1.

onboard-bot: created draft: /internal/cs/kickoff-primer-stream-prefill (preview) :page_with_curl:

Nora (CS): feedback capture (24-48h): 1) avg QPS + first-token p95, 2) any stream disconnects with timestamps, 3) customer sentiment: ok/borderline/blocked. leaving this open for one quick tweak. :white_check_mark:
